name: fairtask
description: Screen SWE-bench-style coding tasks for fairness: under-specified issues and tests that only accept the original fix. Verdicts with verified evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Is this SWE-bench-style task fair enough to grade an agent on?
interface.longDescription: fairtask screens a candidate task — a GitHub issue plus the pull request that fixed it — for the two defects that make it unfair: an under-specified issue, and tests that only accept the original author's choices. A judge agent dispatches two specialist probes with read-only access to the repository at the base commit; a deterministic verifier checks every quoted line. Measured against OpenAI's human SWE-bench Verified annotations. On first use the skill clones the pinned engine release into ~/.fairtask, installs its npm dependencies and runs it; screening reads the task's repository and calls the Claude API.
defaultPrompt: Use the fairtask skill to check whether SWE-bench task django__django-11099 is fair.
Use the fairtask skill to screen pull request 12544 of astropy/astropy before it becomes a task.
